caps.why: Placeholder shipping on a live build: portraits/paine.png returns 404 and Paine renders as an ink 'P' monogram in both FFX-2 party-prep surfaces; seven further speaker portraits (shuyin, yuna-x2, rikku-x2, braska, yu-yevon, fayth-boy, young-auron) also 404. Confirmed twice: w3-portraits.json HTTP probe and the .prep__face DOM audit.

Chief critic's ruling. All five chapters reached VICTORY on the live build with the intended tactics (74/194 turns, 7 links, 77 turns, 5 links) and headlessly at 17/30, 29/30, 29/30, 15/15, 15/15. The Yu Yevon stalemate 'escape' terminus occurs only on deliberately-wrong attack-only or defend-only lines, so it is issue #16, not an unfinishable chapter.
No verbatim transcript lifting found in any of the five scripts (analyse.mjs); no retail asset in public/art or the shipped bundle.

Wrong information shown to the player, proven twice on the live build: (a) src/engine/tactics/advisor.ts:441 describes single-target HASTE as 'Speeds the party's turns up' because the branch is `def.targeting.startsWith('all-all') || heals`; (b) the party status row reports 'Yuna 711 /1500' in living colours for 2145 ms after the engine logs her ko event (ko2.json).
The owner's only recorded audio verdict (2026-09-19) is 'Right direction, keep refining' — not a rejection.
No owner numeric score on record for this build's audio (docs/audio/OWNER-VERDICT.md records a direction check, not a score).

proposalsNote: No design proposals this round. Every category auditor stayed on defects and the chief critic adds none: at a 4.09 headline this build needs the teaching layer, two honest panels and two engine fixes, not new ideas. The one thing needing the owner's attention is a gap, not a proposal: four board tiles that already exist as built surfaces (move advisor card, defeat screen, enemy next-move panel, cold open and taught first chapter) have no approved target and are being iterated on blind. One options round covering those four would unblock issues #1, #11 and #22 and close four of the nine coverage holes.
